import shutil
from pathlib import Path

def _apply_folder_permissions(note_path: Path, folder_path: Path) -> None:
    # Make the moved note inherit the destination folder's access bits (minus execute)
    folder_mode = folder_path.stat().st_mode & 0o777
    note_path.chmod(folder_mode & 0o666)

def move_note_to_notebook_folder(notes_root: str, note_relative_path: str, destination_folder: str, new_file_name: str=None) -> str:
    knowledge_base_root_directory = Path(notes_root).resolve()
    source_note_absolute_path = (knowledge_base_root_directory / note_relative_path).resolve()
    destination_directory_absolute_path = (knowledge_base_root_directory / destination_folder).resolve()
    if knowledge_base_root_directory not in source_note_absolute_path.parents:
        raise ValueError('Source note is outside the knowledge base')
    if knowledge_base_root_directory not in destination_directory_absolute_path.parents and destination_directory_absolute_path != knowledge_base_root_directory:
        raise ValueError('Destination folder is outside the knowledge base')
    if not source_note_absolute_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Note not found: {note_relative_path}')
    final_file_name_for_note = new_file_name or source_note_absolute_path.name
    destination_note_absolute_path = destination_directory_absolute_path / final_file_name_for_note
    if destination_note_absolute_path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f'Target already exists: {destination_note_absolute_path.name}')
    destination_directory_absolute_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(source_note_absolute_path), str(destination_note_absolute_path))
    _apply_folder_permissions(destination_note_absolute_path, destination_directory_absolute_path)
    return str(destination_note_absolute_path.relative_to(knowledge_base_root_directory))
